◆ Introduction ◆
Interastral Peace Entertainment's blockbuster talent show has officially begun!

◆ Event Rules ◆
● After the event starts, a new challenge stage will be unlocked daily, with 5 stages in total.
● Each challenge stage is split into "Warm-Up Phase" and "Finals Phase."
● In challenge stages, Trailblazers can use designated trial characters to participate in the challenge, or swap in the characters they have.

◆ Gameplay Intro ◆
● In each stage, Trailblazers can accumulate Popularity during the "Warm-Up Phase" by breaking enemy Shields.
● Popularity can activate buffs. These buffs take effect not only in the "Warm-Up Phase," but can also be carried over into the "Finals Phase."
● After entering the "Finals Phase," puncture the formidable foe's HP bar as many times as possible to obtain the corresponding "Rating Rewards."
● If your owned characters (Level, Traces, Relics, and Eidolons) and Light Cone levels do not meet the build requirements, they will be automatically enhanced by the system, recruiting a mapped version of the character and Light Cone. This enhancement is only effective in the event.

◆ Event Rewards ◆
● During the event, after completing designated challenge goals in the stages, you can claim rewards in "Limited-Time Rewards."
● During the event, after achieving an SS rating in all stages, you can claim the Collection Showcase item "Showstopper" Medal in "Commemorative Medals."
